Description: A Greek papyrus fragment of Exodus from Qumran Cave 7, catalogued as 7Q1, preserving Exodus 28:4-7 (priestly garments). It is a Greek translation, not a Hebrew copy, and is described in some scholarship as closer to the Hebrew text than to the later Septuagint tradition.
Significance: The only identified Greek Exodus fragment from Qumran, attesting Greek Scripture use alongside Hebrew scrolls.
